q: 71. Of the following the PERT event is
explain: An event is a milestone (a completion point). 'Concrete cured' marks a completed state; the others are activities.

q: 72. In PERT analysis the actual performance of task is known is
explain: Per the answer key, b. Note: by standard definition the performance of a task is an activity, so the stem or key looks misprinted.

q: 73. In PERT analysis, the start and end of event is represented by
explain: Per the answer key, b (event).

q: 74. Which of the following in an activity?
explain: An activity consumes time and resources. 'Excavation for foundation' is ongoing work, while the other two describe completed states (events).

q: 75. An activity requires
explain: Every activity needs both time and resources.

q: 76. A drawback of the bar chart is that
options: it is difficult to judge whether an activity is completed or not
all the activities represented are independent of each other
sequence of activities is not clearly defined
it is not possible to judge whether the activity is ahead or behind schedule
explain: Bar charts do not show the logical sequence or interdependence of activities.

q: 77. Milestones are
options: the events specifying the beginning and/or the end of subdivided activities
the stones indicating the distance along a highway
dates of important happenings in the history of any nation
explain: Milestones are key events marking the start or end of subdivided activities.

q: 78. Henry Gantt developed the bar chart technique around
explain: Henry Gantt developed the bar chart around 1900 (roughly 1910-1915).

q: 79. Milestone charts are developed around
explain: Per the answer key, 1940.

q: 80. The earliest method used for planning of projects was
explain: The bar chart (Gantt chart) predates milestone charts, CPM and PERT.

q: 81. Bar charts are suitable only for
explain: Per the answer key, a. Bar charts cannot show complex interdependencies, so they suit small projects.

q: 82. PERT is an abbreviation for
options: pertinent equation related to a task
explain: PERT = Programme (Program) Evaluation and Review Technique.

q: 83. Expected project duration generally follows
explain: Per the answer key, a. The project duration is a sum of many activity times, so by the central limit theorem it is taken as normal. Activity times follow the beta curve.

q: 84. The area under the β-distribution curve is divided into two equal parts by
explain: The expected time divides the area into two equal halves, so there is a 50% chance on either side.

q: 85. Which of the following does not represent an activity?
options: The office area is being cleaned
explain: 'Site located' is a completed state (an event). The rest are ongoing tasks.

q: 86. The most suitable type of equipment for compaction of cohesive soils is
explain: Sheep foot rollers knead and compact clayey (cohesive) soils.

q: 87. CPM stands for
explain: CPM = Critical Path Method.

q: 88. PERT is
explain: PERT is event oriented, since its network is analysed in terms of events.

q: 89. CPM is
explain: CPM is activity oriented.

q: 90. PERT adopts
explain: PERT uses three time estimates and probability, so it is probabilistic.

q: 91. CPM adopts
explain: CPM uses a single fixed time estimate, so it is deterministic.

q: 92. Which of the following statements is true?
options: PERT is activity oriented and adopts deterministic approach
CPM is event oriented and adopts probabilistic approach
CPM is activity oriented and adopts probabilistic approach
PERT is event oriented and adopts probabilistic approach
explain: PERT is event oriented and probabilistic. CPM is activity oriented and deterministic.

q: 93. When the events are numbered in a network then the number of the head event of an activity is
options: always larger than the number of the tail event of same activity
always smaller than the number of the tail event of the same activity
always equal to the number of the tail event of the same activity
explain: By Fulkerson's rule, the head event number is always greater than the tail event number.

q: 94. The time corresponding to minimum total project cost is
options: between normal time and crash time
explain: The optimum duration lies between the normal and crash times, where direct plus indirect cost is lowest.

q: 95. The cost slope is defined as
options: (crash cost – normal cost) / (normal time – crash time)
explain: Cost slope = extra cost per unit of time saved = (crash cost – normal cost)/(normal time – crash time).

q: 96. While bid evaluation, if unit rate and total amount are contradicted, then which of the following will prevail
options: unit price is adopted and total amount is corrected
explain: The unit price governs, and the total amount is corrected by arithmetic.

q: 97. In QCBS method of procurement, evaluation of consulting firms to award the contract, the weightage will be
explain: Per the answer key, 80% technical and 20% financial.

q: 98. Earliest finish of an activity is always
options: greater than earliest event time of the following node
less than earliest event time of the following node
less than or equal to earliest event time of the following node
greater than or equal to earliest event time of the following node
explain: The following node's earliest time is the maximum of the earliest finishes of all activities entering it, so EF ≤ it.

q: 99. Select the incorrect statement
options: earliest start of an activity is the early event time of the node it leaves
latest finish of an activity is the late event time of the node it enters
latest start of an activity is its latest finish minus its duration
explain: All three statements are correct, so 'none of the above' is the answer.

q: 100. If the optimistic time, most likely time and pessimistic time for activity A are 4, 6 and 8 respectively and for activity B are 5, 5.5 and 9 respectively, then
options: expected time of activity A is greater than the expected time of activity B
expected time of activity B is greater than the expected time of activity A
expected time of both activities A and B are same
explain: tE(A) = (4+24+8)/6 = 6 and tE(B) = (5+22+9)/6 = 6, so they are equal.

q: 101. If an activity has its optimistic, most likely and pessimistic times as 2, 3 and 7 respectively, then its expected time and variance are respectively
102. Select the incorrect statement
options: start float and finish float are always equal
total float can be either start float or finish float
start float and finish float need not be equal
start float and finish float are the differences between activity times and not event times
explain: Per the answer key, c. Note: standard theory says start and finish float are equal for an activity, so the key looks questionable.

q: 103. For a given size of bucket, the ideal output of a dragline will be least in
explain: Wet sticky clay is hard to dig and sticks in the bucket, so the output is lowest.

q: 104. Which one of the following surface will give highest coefficient of traction while using crawler track tractors?
explain: Per the answer key, earth, where the track grousers can grip.

q: 105. Which of the following surfaces will give highest rolling resistance for a rubber tyred vehicle?
explain: Tyres sink into loose sand, giving the highest rolling resistance.

q: 106. The probability of completion of any activity within its expected time is
explain: At the expected time Z = 0, so the probability is 50%.

q: 107. Functional organization system of working was introduced by
explain: F. W. Taylor introduced functional organization.

q: 108. In resources levelling
options: total duration of project is increased
uniform demand of resources is achieved
explain: Resource levelling aims at a uniform demand for resources, and may extend the project duration.

q: 109. Total cost of the project is
options: direct cost and outage loss of project
explain: Total cost = direct cost + indirect cost.

q: 110. In time-cost optimisation of a project, crashing is done
options: on all the activities lying on the critical paths
only on activities lying on the original critical path and having flatter cost slopes
on original critical activities and those that become critical
explain: Per the answer key, c. (The same question appears later with option d as the key answer, in Q175.)

q: 111. Site order book is used for recoding
options: indents for materials to be ordered
explain: The site order book records the engineer's instructions to the contractor.

q: 112. The problem of developing, low cost housing for economically backward people in undeveloped region should be analysed by
explain: Per the answer key, a. Note: option d is a misprint in the book.

q: 113. In PERT technique the critical path has slack equal to
explain: Critical path slack is zero, or negative if the schedule is behind.

q: 114. Bid bond is ……… % of quoted amount.
explain: Per the answer key, 2.5%.

q: 115. Contractor is liable to maintain the defects upto
explain: The contractor must rectify defects during the defect liability period.

q: 116. Direct purchase can be done for procurement of consulting services or construction works upto
options: 5 lakh in case of consulting services
5 lakh in case of construction works
explain: Per the answer key, both limits apply.

q: 117. The CPM network is updated
options: whenever the is difference in the planned and actual performance
explain: The network is updated whenever actual progress differs from the plan.

q: 118. The effect of network compression is increase in the
explain: Compressing the network (crashing) increases direct cost and reduces indirect cost.

q: 119. The scheduling of project activities is dine in such a way that it consumes resources
options: greater at the start, lesser at the end
lesser at the start, greater at the end
explain: Good scheduling gives a uniform resource demand (levelling).

q: 120. The process of inspiring the subordinates to do work or achieve an objective is called as
explain: Inspiring people to achieve an objective is motivation.

q: 121. In a barchart the vertical axis represents
explain: Activities are listed on the vertical axis and time on the horizontal axis.

q: 122. The barchart technique is commonly used because it
options: is simple to draw and easy to understand
is useful for cost and quality control
explain: Per the answer key, a. Its popularity comes from being simple to draw and understand.

q: 123. The main function of the construction management is
explain: Management covers planning, organising, directing and controlling.

q: 124. Each work should be planned with respect to
options: manner of execution of the work
explain: Planning considers the execution method, urgency and resource availability.

q: 125. In construction work, the controlling function aims at
options: keeping a watch over the physical progress of each activity of the work
controlling the expenditure on each item of work
controlling the use of machines and materials
explain: Control covers progress, expenditure, and machines and materials.

q: 126. Which of the following is an example of parallel activities?
options: Construction of walls and casting of roof
Construction of walls and carpentry work of doors and window
Casting of roof and construction of septic tank
Digging of well and construction of septic tank
explain: Per the answer key, b. Wall construction and door/window carpentry can proceed at the same time.

q: 127. The occurrence of the completion of an activity is called its
explain: The completion event is the head event, at the arrowhead.

q: 128. The occurrence of the starting of an activity is called its
explain: The starting event is the tail event.

q: 129. A dual role event
options: is the head events as well as a tail event
is the beginning of one event and the end of another
is any event other than the initial and final events
explain: Per the answer key, d. A dual role event is any event other than the first and last, since it is the head of some activities and the tail of others.

q: 130. If the path of activities leads back into itself, the resulting error in the network is known as
explain: A closed cycle of activities is a loop (looping error).

q: 131. In PERT, the critical path represents the
options: shortest path of the earliest completion of the project
longest path of the network from the initial to final event
ideal path by proceeding along which the project can be completed as per schedule
path which takes into account the completion of the parallel activities
explain: The critical path is the longest path from the initial to the final event and fixes the project duration.

q: 132. The optimistic time estimate represents
options: the shortest time required to complete the activity under favorable conditions
the maximum time required to complete the activity under adverse conditions
the time the activity would most often require if normal conditions prevail
explain: Optimistic time is the shortest time if everything goes well.

q: 133. If t_o, t_p and t_L represent the optimistic, pessimistic and most likely time estimates, the expected time of completion of the activity is given by
explain: PERT (beta distribution) gives t_E = (t_o + 4t_L + t_p)/6.

q: 134. The probability distribution taken to represent the completion time in PERT analysis is
explain: PERT assumes activity times follow the beta distribution.
